shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md
sed -n '1,500p' ../round-brief.md
git status --short --branch
rg -n \"Measured semantics|Usage reported|validated by|VALIDATED_BY\" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
rg --files scripts/spec-links package.json | sort"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "''^('"\\s*)(it|test)\\(|describe\\(\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
rg -n \"chatOrchestrator\\.test\\.ts\" specs adrs 2>/dev/null
sed -n '1,520p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | sed -n '140,175p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,240p'
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '1,280p'
git diff --check
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix usage spec traceability" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
